title: Urban Cycling
text:
Cities across Europe have invested heavily in cycling infrastructure over the past decade. As a result, the number of daily cycle trips has risen sharply in many centres. Moreover, cycling reduces traffic congestion and lowers local air pollution. Nonetheless, cyclists still face significant risks at busy junctions.

To illustrate this point, Copenhagen is often cited as a model. Its network of protected lanes, however, took decades to build. Furthermore, the city introduced traffic lights that give cyclists priority. Therefore, other cities seeking similar results should expect a long-term commitment rather than a quick fix.

questions.text: According to paragraph one, what effect has investment in cycling infrastructure had?
options: Daily cycle trips have risen sharply in many centres
Car ownership has doubled in every city
Pollution levels have increased in most cities

questions.text: According to paragraph two, what took decades to build in Copenhagen?
What does the writer imply by using 'Nonetheless' in paragraph one?
options: Safety problems for cyclists limit the benefits just described
Cycling brings no benefits to cities
Junctions are safer than cycle lanes

questions.text: Which conclusion is best supported by paragraph two?
options: Other cities can achieve similar results quickly and cheaply
Lasting cycling success requires sustained, long-term investment
Copenhagen's model cannot be applied anywhere else
Traffic lights are the most important factor in cycling success

paragraph_translations: Avrupa'daki pek çok şehir son on yılda bisiklet altyapısına büyük yatırımlar yaptı. Bunun sonucunda birçok merkezde günlük bisiklet yolculuklarının sayısı keskin biçimde arttı. Ayrıca bisiklet, trafik sıkışıklığını azaltır ve yerel hava kirliliğini düşürür. Yine de bisikletliler, yoğun kavşaklarda hâlâ ciddi risklerle karşı karşıya.

Bu noktayı örneklendirmek için Kopenhag sıklıkla bir model olarak gösterilir. Ancak korumalı şerit ağı kurulması on yıllar sürdü. Ayrıca şehir, bisikletlilere öncelik tanıyan trafik ışıkları uyguladı. Bu nedenle benzer sonuçlar isteyen diğer şehirler, hızlı bir çözüm yerine uzun vadeli bir taahhüt beklemelidir.
